title: Recruitment Hackathon 26/27
description: Write the software that drives a 1/10-scale racing car around a circuit it has never seen, as fast as it can, without hitting anything. Two tracks, two simulators, one problem.

stats.foot: Pick one · both score out of 100

tracks.name: Track 1
tracks.title: RoboRacer Autonomous Racing
tracks.lede: Everything in one repository — simulator, judging environment and every official track. No driver ships: you pick the algorithm and write it. Ask the car for a speed and a steering angle; the sim closes the loop for you.
specs: Our referee, against a finish line

tracks.name: Track 2
tracks.title: RoboRacer Sim Racing on AutoDRIVE
tracks.lede: The compete phase of the RoboRacer Sim Racing League at ICRA 2026 — same vehicle, same sensors, same circuit the ICRA teams raced. You publish raw throttle, so the speed controller is yours to write.
